# Visit Copenhagen

> > Official guide to Copenhagen and Denmark, featuring New Nordic dining, UNESCO-recognized architecture by BIG and Arne Jacobsen, sustainable tourism, and cultural experiences across neighborhoods like Nørrebro and North Zealand.

Visit Copenhagen is the official tourism portal for Denmark's capital and surrounding regions. The site covers world-class museums like Thorvaldsens Museum, green spaces including King's Garden and Kalvebod Fælled, architectural landmarks like Grundtvig's Church, and day trips to North Zealand and Amager island.

## Key Topics

- Copenhagen neighborhoods (Nørrebro, Islands Brygge, Vestamager)
- Danish architecture (BIG/Bjarke Ingels Group, Arne Jacobsen, Henning Larsen)
- Sustainable tourism and CopenPay eco-rewards
- New Nordic cuisine and Michelin dining
- Green spaces (King's Garden, Frederiksberg Garden, Kalvebod Fælled)
- North Zealand and Amager day trips
- Danish design and museums (Designmuseum Denmark, Thorvaldsens Museum)
- Grundtvig's Church and cultural landmarks
- Copenhagen Cultural District with 19 museums
- Outdoor activities (cycling, harbour baths, ice skating)
- Bertel Thorvaldsen and Vilhelm Hammershøi art
- Frederiksberg Garden and Enghaveparken
- Coffee culture and specialty roasters
- UNESCO World Architecture Capital 2023

## Trip Planning & Essential Information

- [Plan your trip](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/planning/plan-your-trip): Trip planning hub: transport, Copenhagen Card & Visitor Service info
- [Basic need-to-know information](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/planning/travel-info/basic-need-know-information): Essential travel info: Danish Kroner currency, VAT refunds & practical tips

## Architecture & Design

- [Guide to modern architecture in Copenhagen](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/copenhagen/campaigns/experience-world-class-modern-architecture-aa): UNESCO Architecture Capital: BIG, Henning Larsen & sustainable design
- [The Architect's Guide to Copenhagen - Dan Stubbergaard](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/copenhagen/get-local/architects-guide-copenhagen-dan-stubbergaard): COBE founder Dan Stubbergaard shares architectural favorites like Grundtvig's
- [World-class culture and design: A wonderful reason to visit the north of Copenhagen](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/neighbourhoods/beyond-copenhagen/world-class-culture-and-design-wonderful-reason-visit-north-copenhagen): North Copenhagen cultural attractions: Designmuseum Denmark & Bellevue Beach

## Museums & Cultural Attractions

- [Experience Copenhagen Cultural District](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/activities/museums-and-attractions/experience-copenhagen-cultural-district): 19 museums including Danish Architecture Center & The Black Diamond library
- [The Hammershøi effect](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/activities/museums-and-attractions/hammershoi-effect): Vilhelm Hammershøi's influence on Danish art & Nordic design aesthetics

## Dining & Coffee Culture

- [Restaurants Copenhagen](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/copenhagen/campaigns/restaurants-copenhagen-ac): Dining guide: Michelin restaurants, New Nordic cuisine & smørrebrød spots
- [Best coffee bars in Copenhagen](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/eat-drink/coffee-and-bakeries/best-coffee-bars-copenhagen): Top specialty coffee bars: The Coffee Collective, Prolog & ROAST

## Parks & Green Spaces

- [Green Copenhagen: The best parks and gardens](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/activities/outdoor/parks): Best Copenhagen parks: King's Garden, Botanical Garden & Frederiksberg
- [Peace, tranquility, and idyll in Copenhagen's green spaces](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/activities/outdoor/peace-tranquility-and-idyll-copenhagens-green-spaces): Guide to peaceful parks, museums & churches in Copenhagen's green spaces

## Neighborhoods & Local Life

- [Street guide: Blågårdsgade](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/neighbourhoods/neighborhoods/street-guide-blagardsgade): Nørrebro's Blågårdsgade street: cafés, wine bars & music venues
- [Harbour hang-out: Islands Brygge](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/neighbourhoods/neighborhoods/harbour-hang-out-islands-brygge): Islands Brygge neighborhood: harbour baths, GoBoat & waterfront dining
- [Podcast: Insider's Guide to Copenhagen - Bikes, coffee and urban spaces](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/copenhagen/get-local/podcast-insiders-guide-copenhagen-bikes-coffee-and-urban-spaces): Aldo Pavia's podcast tour of Nørrebro & Nordvest cycling culture

## Day Trips & Beyond Copenhagen

- [17 reasons to explore beyond Copenhagen city limit](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/beyond-copenhagen/beyond-copenhagen/18-reasons-explore-beyond-city-limit): Day trips guide: Kystbanen coastal train to Møns Klint & North Zealand
- [Fredensborg: Three reasons to head north to this charming castle town](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/beyond-copenhagen/beyond-copenhagen/fredensborg-three-reasons-head-north-charming-castle-town): Day trip to Fredensborg Palace & Lake Esrum, 30km north of Copenhagen
- [Amager nature & coast](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/neighbourhoods/beyond-copenhagen/amager-nature-coast): Amager island guide: Nature Park, beaches & coastal activities near airport
- [Furesø - Active nature experiences](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/neighbourhoods/beyond-copenhagen/fureso-active-nature-experiences): Furesø lake activities: Denmark's deepest lake, biking &Værløse Air Base

## Sustainable Tourism & Seasonal Activities

- [Attractions CopenPay](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/copenhagen/campaigns/24-attractions-rewarding-your-climate-friendly-actions-2024): CopenPay eco-rewards: get benefits for biking & climate-friendly actions
- [Go ice skating in Copenhagen](https://www.visitcopenhagen.com/copenhagen/copenhagen/seasons/go-ice-skating-copenhagen): Winter ice skating rinks at Frederiksberg Garden & Enghaveparken
